<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/auth/me/calendar-feed"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates your personal calendar subscription URL, or replaces the one
you already have: each member has at most one, and the previous URL
stops working immediately. The URL is returned **exactly once** — the
server stores only a SHA-256 hash of its secret.

The URL's origin is the server's **Public address** setting when the
admin set one, otherwise the origin this request reached the server
at. `webcalUrl` is the same URL with the `webcal://` scheme, which
most operating systems hand to the default calendar app as a
subscription.

The URL is independent of your password: changing or resetting it
leaves the subscription working (like personal access tokens).
Session-authenticated requests only — a personal access token gets a
`403`, so a leaked token can't mint calendar URLs.
